spec.model: Equal-weight sequence mixture of the two factorizations. Each factor has first-order KT smoothing (0.5/cell). Second-order rows shrink to the fitted first-order row with concentration 2.0. Prefix-only parameter fitting; no suffix updating.
spec.conditional_null: Keep positions 1..43 fixed. Uniform Euler shuffle of positions 43..87, preserving its first/last signs and all directed bigram counts. Thus all global directed bigrams and symbol counts are unchanged.
spec.relabel_null: Uniform permutation of all 24 glyph identities onto the 24 geometric forms; refit prefix and score suffix with identical models.
spec.decision: Investigate only if gain>0 and upper-tail plus-one fraction<=0.01 for BOTH conditional and geometric-relabel controls on BOTH transcriptions, synthetic second-order detection>=80/100, and first-order false positives<=5/100. Otherwise close this model without retuning. Both transcriptions are dependent, not independent replications.
spec.synthetic: Independent uniform initial feature pairs. Each axis(4), polarity(2), arc(3) has a random deterministic table. At each later step use table with probability 0.90, else uniform. Negative table has one lag; positive table has two lags. Same lengths, fitting and conditional test; no real-derived parameters.
spec.calibration_scope: Synthetic detectability checks for deliberately strong local dependence only, not historical or language validation. Previously seen 14 letters are descriptive challenge cases, not new positives for geometric generation.
spec.limits: Adaptive research on an already studied document. Split is computational only, not new unseen historical evidence. A pass would not establish no-language, hoax, original intent, a cipher key or decipherment. A fail only stops this specific predictive model.
